commits.subject: Initial release: Claude Code Telegram Bot
commits.body:
This is the first release of the Claude Code Telegram Bot, providing remote access to Claude Code through Telegram with a terminal-like interface.

## Features
- 🤖 Full Claude AI integration with session persistence
- 📱 Terminal-like interface for remote development
- 🛡️ Enterprise-grade security with access control and rate limiting
- 📁 Project navigation and file management
- 🔄 Session management with proper Claude Code integration
- 📊 Usage tracking and cost monitoring

## Key Fixes in This Release
- Fixed session ID management to use Claude Code generated IDs
- Fixed directory navigation from projects list
- Implemented comprehensive error handling for usage limits and tool validation
- Added support for all common Claude Code tools

## Architecture
- Async Python with Telegram Bot API
- SQLite database with repository pattern
- Pydantic Settings v2 for configuration
- Comprehensive test suite (187/188 tests passing)

commits.body:
Enhanced the /continue command to be much more useful and functional:

## New Features
- Actually continues Claude sessions instead of just showing a message
- Supports optional prompt: `/continue [message]`
- Uses Claude Code's --continue flag when no prompt provided
- Uses --resume with prompt when message included
- Smart session detection (current context -> recent session fallback)
- Real-time status updates and progress feedback
- Comprehensive error handling with actionable suggestions

## Implementation Details
- Updated command handler to call Claude integration directly
- Enhanced callback handler for "Continue" button functionality
- Added proper session ID management and context updates
- Improved user experience with clear feedback and error messages
- Updated help text and README documentation

## Usage Examples
- `/continue` - Continues where you left off
- `/continue Can you explain this code?` - Continues with new message
- "🔄 Continue" button now actually continues the session

This makes /continue a proper, functional feature that users will actually want to use.

- **Simplified setup**: Users don't need separate API key if already logged into Claude CLI
- **Better user experience**: Seamless transition from CLI to SDK
- **Flexible deployment**: Support both authentication methods as needed
- **Backward compatibility**: Existing API key configurations continue to work

**Authentication Flow**:
1. If `anthropic_api_key` is provided → Use API key authentication
2. If no API key provided → Use existing Claude CLI authentication

+- Uses your existing Claude CLI authentication
+- Better streaming and error handling
+- No need to manage API keys separately
+
+**Cons:**
+- Requires Claude CLI installation
+
+#### Option B: SDK with Direct API Key
+
+This method uses the Python SDK with a direct API key, bypassing the need for Claude CLI.
+
+```bash
+# 1. Get your API key from https://console.anthropic.com/
+# 2. Configure bot (in step 4 below)
+USE_SDK=true
+ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-api03-your-key-here
+```
+
+**Pros:**
+- No Claude CLI installation required
+- Direct API integration
+- Good performance with async support
+
+**Cons:**
+- Need to manage API keys manually
+- API key management and rotation
+
+#### Option C: CLI Subprocess Mode (Legacy)
+
+This method uses the Claude CLI as a subprocess. Use this only if you need compatibility with older setups.
+
+```bash
+# 1. Install Claude CLI
+# Visit https://claude.ai/code and follow installation instructions
+
+# 2. Authenticate with Claude
+claude auth login
+
+# 3. Configure bot (in step 4 below)
+USE_SDK=false
+# ANTHROPIC_API_KEY not needed for CLI mode
+```
+
+**Pros:**
+- Uses official Claude CLI
+- Compatible with all CLI features
+
+**Cons:**
+- Slower than SDK integration
+- Subprocess overhead
+- Less reliable error handling
+
+### 3. Install the Bot
+
+```bash
+# Clone the repository
+git clone https://github.com/yourusername/claude-code-telegram.git
+cd claude-code-telegram
+
+# Install Poetry (if needed)
+curl -sSL https://install.python-poetry.org | python3 -
+
+# Install dependencies
+make dev
+```
+
+### 4. Configure Environment
+
+```bash
+# Copy the example configuration
+cp .env.example .env
+
+# Edit with your settings
+nano .env
+```
+
+**Required Configuration:**
+
+```bash
+# Telegram Bot Settings
+TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=1234567890:ABC-DEF1234ghIkl-zyx57W2v1u123ew11

+2. It will reply with your user ID number
+3. Add this number to your `ALLOWED_USERS` setting
+
+### 6. Run the Bot
+
+```bash
+# Start in debug mode (recommended for first run)
+make run-debug
+
+# Or for production
+make run
+```
+
+### 7. Test the Bot
+
+1. Find your bot on Telegram (search for your bot username)
+2. Send `/start` to begin
+3. Try a simple command like `/pwd` or `/ls`
+4. Test Claude integration with a simple question
